lines.text:
I’m searching for items that boost a Pokémon’s
stats for the length of one battle.\c
X Attack, X Defense, X Speed, and X Sp. Atk...
Those are what I’m after!\c
Do you know where I can get them?
Did you buy some Revives?\nThey’ll revive a Pokémon that fainted.\r\nThey’re really handy!

If a Support Trainer battles alongside you,
you can have two Pokémon on your side to take
on one opposing Pokémon!\c
You can have the upper hand!
